question: Estimate monthly orders for Zomato in Bengaluru.
idealClarificationQuestions: Food delivery only or include Hyperpure (B2B), Blinkit (quick commerce)? Food delivery only.
Greater Bengaluru or core city? Greater Bengaluru (~14M).
Zomato's market share assumption? Roughly 50-55% of food delivery in Bengaluru (Bengaluru is a Zomato stronghold).
Average month or peak (festive, IPL)? Average month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Same as Mumbai food delivery, but adjust for Bengaluru's demographics (higher tech-employed population, higher ordering frequency) and apply Zomato share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Food delivery users: ~40% of smartphone adults = ~3.6M (higher than Mumbai due to large young/single tech workforce).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Monthly orders (total food delivery in Bengaluru) = 650K×18 + 1.26M×7 + 1.7M×1.5 = 11.7M + 8.8M + 2.6M ≈ 23M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round to ~11-12 million monthly Zomato orders in Bengaluru.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~40% of smartphone adults = ~3.6M (higher than Mumbai due to large young/single tech workforce).

calculationFlow: Smartphone + internet adults: ~9M (high penetration — IT hub).
Food delivery users: ~40% of smartphone adults = ~3.6M (higher than Mumbai due to large young/single tech workforce).
Monthly orders (total food delivery in Bengaluru) = 650K×18 + 1.26M×7 + 1.7M×1.5 = 11.7M + 8.8M + 2.6M ≈ 23M.
Round to ~11-12 million monthly Zomato orders in Bengaluru.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Round to ~11-12 million monthly Zomato orders in Bengaluru.
